spiritual_communion: Jeesusi oqarpunga, uanga ilinnut qanillunga, uanga ilinnut naapittunga. Uanga ilinnut asannittunga, aamma uanga ilinnut najuuttunga. Naalagaq, uanga ilinnut qanillunga, aamma uanga ilinnut asannittunga.
closing: Naalagaq Guuti, ilissi tamaasa asannilluni, ilissi tamaasa eqqissinartup ilissi tamaasa najuuffigissavaasi. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin aamma tamarmik toqusimasut pillugit, Kristusip qaamanerani eqqissillutik sinissasut.
Tamarmik naalliuutillutik qiaasut pillugit, Guutip eqqissisillugit neriunermillu tunissasut.

readings.label: Atuarfik 1
readings.text: Johanip oqaatigaa: Angelip takutippaanga inuunermik imeq, kristal-itut seqerpaluttoq, Guutip aamma Savaaraap inissiaataaniit kuuttoq, aqqusernup qeqqaniit. Aqqutip illuatungilii tamaasa inuunermik orpiit naapput, qaammammut ataasiarlutik inuussutissartallit; orpiit pilutai inunnut napparsimasunut nakorsaatitut atortarput. Tassa, nalaatsornerit tamaasa, inuup toquneranik kinguneqartut, peerupput. Guutip aamma Savaaraap inissiaat najuuppoq, aamma kiffai ataqqissavaat. Taakku kiinaa takussavaat, aamma ateq taassuma niaquiniippoq. Unnuarissaaq, aamma ikummatissamik imaluunniit seqernup qaamaneranik pisariaqartitsissanngillat, Naalagaq Guutip qaamanerani tunissammagit, aamma inuussapput naassaanngitsumik. Aamma oqarpoq: 'Oqaatsit taakku tatigineqarsinnaapput aamma ilumoortut, aamma Naalagaq, anersaakkut siulittuisup Guutia, angelini nassiuppaa kiffani takutinniarlugit qanoq pisussat. Takoriuk, qanittukkut aggerpunga. Pissaanerussaaq kinaluunniit atuakkap matuma siulittuutai atortoq.'

readings.label: Evangelium
readings.text: Jesus oqarpoq: 'Mianersoritsi ilissi uummatissi sinilersinneqassanngitsut imernermit aamma imigassamik, aamma ulluinnarni ernumanermit, aamma ullu taanna tassanngaannartumik pisussaq. Ullu taanna nunamiittunut tamanut pisussaq. Mianersoritsi aamma qinullusi, nukissaqarnissassi, taakkunannga naalliuutinit aniguinissassi aamma Savaaraap Ernerata saqqaani inissinnissassi.'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
